_comment: Sign-in throttle vectors both gateways run with one client (go-web-proxy/throttle_test.go TestThrottle_SharedVectors, tests/mock-broker/gateway/throttle.test.ts). Each step does one thing: fail (a failed sign-in for that user, times times, default 1), succeed (a sign-in for that user: it clears that account's count, never the client's), advance (seconds on the clock) or wait (the seconds a sign-in for that user must wait, want). maxFailures is the per-account limit, clientMaxFailures the per-client one, resetMinutes the quiet time after which a count is forgotten.

cases.name: another user's failures survive a success
the client blocks every name once it reaches its limit
a success clears the account's count, not the client's
each failure past the limit doubles the wait, up to the longest back-off
a block ends after its back-off
a count quiet for longer than the reset time starts again
a count quiet for less than the reset time is kept
names are counted by their first 64 bytes
